errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Auth.InvalidCredentials: The phone or email and password don't match an account.
Auth.InvalidMfaCode: That code isn't right. Check your authenticator app and try again.
Auth.MfaChallengeExpired: Your sign-in timed out. Please sign in again.
Auth.Unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
Auth.AccountLockedOut: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
Auth.InvalidPasswordResetToken: This reset link isn't valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
Auth.InvalidEmailConfirmationToken: This confirmation link isn't valid or has expired.
Auth.PhoneAlreadyUsed: Another account already uses this mobile number.
Auth.MfaEnrollmentRequired: Set up two-step sign-in with your authenticator app to continue.
Auth.EmailAlreadyExists: Another account already uses this email.
Auth.AccountNotActive: This account has been deactivated. Contact the clinic if you think this is a mistake.

Validation.InvalidPhone: Enter an Egyptian mobile number, e.g. 010 1234 5678.

Messaging.PhoneUnreachable: We couldn't reach this number on WhatsApp. Check the number, or sign up with another one.

Otp.InvalidCode: That code isn't right or has expired. Attempts left: {{attemptsLeft}}.
Otp.TooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
Otp.ResendTooSoon: Please wait a little before asking for a new code.

Invitation.NotFound: This invitation link isn't valid. It may have been used or cancelled.

DoctorApplication.AlreadyOpen: You already have an open application.
DoctorApplication.InvalidStatusTransition: This application can't be changed in its current stage.
DoctorApplication.ReapplyTooSoon: You can't apply again yet. Your application page shows the date.
DoctorApplication.NotFound: You don't have an application yet.

File.TooLarge: The file is too large for this upload.
File.NotScanned: This file is still being checked for viruses. Try again in a moment.

RateLimit.Exceeded: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.

Access.OutOfScope: You don't have access to this branch's records.

Appointment.SlotInPast: This time has already started. Please pick a later one.
Appointment.CancellationWindowExpired: It's too close to the visit to change it online. Please call the branch.
Appointment.InvalidStatusTransition: This appointment can't be changed in its current status. Refresh to see the latest.
Appointment.ReviewAlreadyExists: You have already reviewed this visit.
Appointment.ReviewNotAllowed: You can review a visit once it is completed.
Appointment.CheckInWindowClosed: Check-in opens an hour before the visit, on the visit day.
Appointment.NoShowTooEarly: A visit can be marked as a no-show 15 minutes after it starts.
Appointment.WalkInCapReached: This doctor can't take more walk-ins today. Book the next free time instead.
Appointment.DoctorBusy: The doctor already has a patient in the room.
Appointment.SlotNotFound: This time no longer exists. Please pick another.
Appointment.Unauthorized: You don't have access to this appointment.

Slot.CapacityReached: Someone just booked this time. Please pick another.

Consent.Required: Please accept the terms to book.

Reminder.LinkInvalid: This reminder link isn't valid any more.

Visit.NotFound: We couldn't find this visit summary.

Invoice.NotDraft: The invoice is already issued, so its services can't change.

Payer.NotFound: We couldn't find this insurance company.

Profile.EmailRequired: Confirm an email address first to get reminders by email.

Payment.GatewayUnavailable: Online payment isn't available right now. Your booking is safe; try again later.
Payment.InvalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero and no more than what is due.
Payment.NoOpenCashSession: Open a cash session before taking cash.

Patient.ProfileNotFound: We couldn't find your patient record. Contact the clinic.

Queue.ReasonRequired: Give a reason for moving this patient.

Vitals.OutOfRange: Some values are outside what can be measured. Check them and try again.

Triage.AllergiesNotConfirmed: Confirm the allergies with the patient first.

CashSession.AlreadyOpen: You already have an open cash session. Close it first.
CashSession.NotOpen: This cash session is already closed.

CashDrawer.InUse: Someone else has this drawer open. Choose another one.

Service.NotFound: This doctor doesn't offer that service.

Branch.NotFound: We couldn't find this branch. It may be closed.

Booking.ServiceNotOffered: This doctor doesn't offer that service at this branch. Please pick another.

Deposit.NotOffered: This visit doesn't take a deposit.

Document.SharedWithDoctor: This document is part of a visit record, so it can't be removed.

Idempotency.KeyReused: This request was already sent with different details. Refresh the page and try again.

Notification.Unauthorized: You don't have access to this notification.
